notes.title: Steam Trading Cards come to Omega Quintet
notes.content:
Hi everyone.

Hope you're all still enjoying Omega Quintet :)

I'm very pleased to say that Steam Trading Cards are now available in Omega Quintet.

Happy Collecting :)
